_rule: Single place a room asset's front is decided (2026-10-25). Render the raw import (bash pipeline/room-glb.sh <id> without an entry -> reviews/20261025/room/glb-views/raw/<id>.jpg), pick by eye the view that matches the sheet front, record it here. matched_view pz->yaw 0, px->-90, nz->180, nx->90 (rotation about up). src_sha256 ties the decision to one source file; a new source re-runs the raw pass.
